profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software continuation fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.store_branch: When SRAM 0xA000-0xA002 is not 0x52 0x54 0x43 ('RTC'), the guest sets the clock chosen by the mode byte, writes the marker, and publishes WRAM C000=0x01.
protocol.mode_byte: SRAM 0xA010: 0xFF or 0x00 = normal 00:00:00 day 0 running; 0x01 = halted at 12:34:56 day 0 (DH=0x40 written last); 0x02 = 23:59:50 day 511 running (DL=0xFF, DH=0x01).
protocol.resume_branch: When the marker is present, the guest writes 0x00 then 0x01 to 0x6000 to latch, reads RTC registers 0x08-0x0C into WRAM C001..C005 (S, M, H, DL, DH), sets C006=0xA5 if the marker is intact, then publishes C000=0x02.
protocol.missing_save: fresh RAM reads 0xFF, so the store branch runs and C000=0x01
protocol.host_delta_rule: result(N) - result(0) == N modulo 512 days; the emulated portion cancels
protocol.evidence: Distinct fresh instances or processes observe the stored clock and marker; this is software continuation evidence only.

scope_limits: No CGB double-speed RTC behavior claim
No BGB footer or other emulator save-format claim
The guest protocol tests file-backed continuation separately from mapper/API correctness
